invariants.rationale: The method uses 'font.getDescent()' and 'font.usesIntegerPositions()' unconditionally, so 'font' must be non-null.
If 'background' is not null, its bottom height is likely non-negative as it represents a UI dimension.
Similarly, top height should also be non-negative for a valid UI drawable.
BitmapFont's descent is conventionally non-positive, as descent means the portion of glyphs below the baseline.
A BitmapFont must have a positive line height to render text meaningfully.
